# react-webcam-kit LLM Context

react-webcam-kit is a TypeScript React package for browser webcam, camera capture, screen capture, camera recording, screen recording, audio recording, upload-ready files, device selection, and media cleanup flows.

Use this file as compact package context for coding assistants, documentation agents, and search tools. Prefer the linked repository docs for the latest full API reference.

## Install

```bash
npm install react-webcam-kit
```

Peer dependency:

```json
{
  "react": ">=18.0.0 || >=19.0.0"
}
```

## What To Import

```tsx
import {
  Webcam,
  blobToFile,
  captureFrame,
  createUploadFormData,
  downloadBlob,
  formatDuration,
  getRecordingPresetConstraints,
  getSupportedMimeType,
  normalizeMediaError,
  useAudioRecorder,
  useCameraPermissions,
  useDevices,
  useDisplayMedia,
  useMediaRecorder,
  useObjectUrl,
  useWebcam,
  type CameraError,
  type WebcamHandle,
} from 'react-webcam-kit';
```

## Choose The API

- Use `<Webcam />` when the app needs a quick camera preview with ref methods.
- Use `useWebcam()` when the app needs a custom camera UI, custom controls, status rendering, or direct stream access.
- Use `useCameraPermissions()` when the app needs a permission prompt before rendering a full camera workflow.
- Use `useDevices()` when the app needs a camera/microphone picker.
- Use `useAudioRecorder()` when the app needs microphone-only recording.
- Use `useDisplayMedia()` when the app needs screen, window, or tab capture.
- Use `useMediaRecorder()` when the app needs to record an active `MediaStream`, show duration, or enforce a max duration.
- Use `getRecordingPresetConstraints()` with recorder `quality` when the app needs named low, medium, high, HD, or full-HD recording targets.
- Use `captureFrame()` when the app already owns a video element and only needs capture helpers.
- Use `useObjectUrl()` when previewing a Blob, File, or MediaSource.
- Use `downloadBlob()` when saving screenshots or recordings.
- Use `createUploadFormData()` when uploading screenshot or recording Blobs.
- Use `formatDuration()` when displaying recorder timer labels.
- Use MIME helpers before setting `MediaRecorder` MIME types.

## Webcam Component

```tsx
import { useRef } from 'react';
import { Webcam, createUploadFormData, type WebcamHandle } from 'react-webcam-kit';

export function CameraPreview() {
  const webcamRef = useRef<WebcamHandle>(null);

  async function uploadAvatar() {
    const blob = await webcamRef.current?.getScreenshotBlob({
      format: 'image/jpeg',
      quality: 0.9,
      width: 512,
      height: 512,
    });

    if (!blob) return;

    const body = createUploadFormData(blob, {
      fieldName: 'avatar',
      fileName: 'avatar.jpg',
    });

    await fetch('/api/avatar', {
      method: 'POST',
      body,
    });
  }

  return (
    <>
      <Webcam
        ref={webcamRef}
        audio={false}
        mirrored
        screenshotFormat="image/jpeg"
        videoConstraints={{
          width: { ideal: 1280 },
          height: { ideal: 720 },
          facingMode: { ideal: 'user' },
        }}
      />
      <button type="button" onClick={() => void uploadAvatar()}>
        Upload avatar
      </button>
    </>
  );
}
```

Important props:

- `audio`: request microphone tracks when true.
- `audioConstraints`: custom microphone constraints.
- `videoConstraints`: custom camera constraints.
- `enabled`: start or stop declaratively.
- `startOnMount`: start automatically on mount. Defaults to true.
- `mirrored`: mirror preview and captured frames.
- `muted`: mute the local preview element without muting stream audio.
- `screenshotFormat`: default capture format.
- `screenshotQuality`: JPEG/WebP capture quality.
- `fallback`: fallback React node or render function for unsupported/error states.
- `onStart`, `onStop`, `onUserMedia`, `onUserMediaError`, `onError`, `onPermissionChange`, `onDevicesChanged`: lifecycle callbacks.

Ref methods:

- `start()`
- `stop()`
- `switchDevice(deviceId, constraints?)`
- `switchFacingMode(mode, constraints?)`
- `applyVideoConstraints(constraints)`
- `getScreenshot(options?)`
- `getScreenshotBlob(options?)`
- `getCanvas(options?)`
- `stream`
- `video`

## Custom Camera UI

```tsx
import { useWebcam } from 'react-webcam-kit';

export function CustomCamera() {
  const camera = useWebcam({
    audio: false,
    startOnMount: false,
    videoConstraints: {
      width: { ideal: 1280 },
      height: { ideal: 720 },
    },
    onError(error) {
      console.error(error.type, error.message);
    },
  });

  return (
    <>
      <video ref={camera.videoRef} autoPlay playsInline muted />

      <button type="button" onClick={() => void camera.start()}>
        Start
      </button>
      <button type="button" onClick={camera.stop}>
        Stop
      </button>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => {
          const image = camera.getScreenshot({
            format: 'image/png',
          });
          console.log(image);
        }}
      >
        Capture
      </button>

      <p>Status: {camera.status}</p>
      <p>Permission: {camera.permission}</p>
    </>
  );
}
```

`useWebcam()` returns stream state, `videoRef`, `stream`, `status`, `permission`, `error`, `selectedDeviceId`, `selectedFacingMode`, `start`, `stop`, `restart`, `switchDevice`, `switchFacingMode`, `applyVideoConstraints`, `getScreenshot`, `getScreenshotBlob`, and `getCanvas`.

## Device Picker

```tsx
import { useDevices, useWebcam } from 'react-webcam-kit';

export function DevicePicker() {
  const devices = useDevices();
  const camera = useWebcam({ audio: false });

  return (
    <select
      value={camera.selectedDeviceId ?? ''}
      onChange={(event) => {
        void camera.switchDevice(event.target.value);
      }}
    >
      <option value="" disabled>
        Select a camera
      </option>
      {devices.videoInputs.map((device) => (
        <option key={device.deviceId} value={device.deviceId}>
          {device.label || 'Camera'}
        </option>
      ))}
    </select>
  );
}
```

`switchDevice()` uses an exact `deviceId` constraint. Use this after the user selects a specific device.

## Front And Back Camera Switching

```tsx
await camera.switchFacingMode('environment');
await camera.switchFacingMode('user');
```

Use `switchFacingMode()` for mobile front/back camera flows. It uses ideal `facingMode` constraints, which are usually safer on mobile devices than strict constraints.

## Recording

```tsx
import {
  createUploadFormData,
  downloadBlob,
  getRecordingPresetConstraints,
  getSupportedMimeType,
  useMediaRecorder,
  useObjectUrl,
  useWebcam,
} from 'react-webcam-kit';

const mimeType = getSupportedMimeType([
  'video/webm;codecs=vp9,opus',
  'video/webm;codecs=vp8,opus',
  'video/webm',
]);

export function Recorder() {
  const camera = useWebcam({
    audio: true,
    videoConstraints: getRecordingPresetConstraints('hd'),
  });
  const recorder = useMediaRecorder({
    stream: camera.stream,
    mimeType: mimeType ?? undefined,
    fileName: 'camera-recording',
    fileType: 'webm',
    quality: 'hd',
  });
  const playbackUrl = useObjectUrl(recorder.blob);

  return (
    <>
      <video ref={camera.videoRef} autoPlay playsInline muted />
      <button type="button" onClick={() => recorder.start()}>
        Record
      </button>
      <button type="button" onClick={recorder.pause}>
        Pause
      </button>
      <button type="button" onClick={recorder.resume}>
        Resume
      </button>
      <button type="button" onClick={recorder.stop}>
        Stop
      </button>
      <button type="button" onClick={recorder.cancel}>
        Discard
      </button>
      <button
        type="button"
        disabled={!recorder.file}
        onClick={() => {
          if (recorder.file) downloadBlob(recorder.file);
        }}
      >
        Download
      </button>
      {playbackUrl ? <video src={playbackUrl} controls /> : null}
    </>
  );
}
```

`useMediaRecorder()` returns `status`, `blob`, `file`, `chunks`, `error`, `isSupported`, `isAudioMuted`, `start`, `stop`, `pause`, `resume`, `reset`, `cancel`, `muteAudio`, `unmuteAudio`, and `setAudioMuted`.

Use `quality: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'hd' | 'full-hd'` for named recorder bitrate targets. Explicit `videoBitsPerSecond`, `audioBitsPerSecond`, or `bitsPerSecond` options override preset bitrates.

Upload a recording with:

```tsx
const recording = recorder.file ?? recorder.blob;

if (recording) {
  const body = createUploadFormData(recording, {
    fieldName: 'video',
    fileName: 'camera-recording.webm',
  });

  await fetch('/api/videos', { method: 'POST', body });
}
```

For audio-only recording, pass an audio-only stream from `navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true, video: false })` to `useMediaRecorder()`.

Prefer `useAudioRecorder()` when the package should request the microphone and own the stream
lifecycle:

```tsx
import { useAudioRecorder, useObjectUrl } from 'react-webcam-kit';

export function VoiceNoteRecorder() {
  const recorder = useAudioRecorder({
    fileName: 'voice-note',
    fileType: 'webm',
    quality: 'medium',
  });
  const playbackUrl = useObjectUrl(recorder.blob);

  return (
    <>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => void recorder.start()}>
        Record voice note
      </button>
      <button type="button" onClick={recorder.stop}>
        Stop
      </button>
      {playbackUrl ? <audio src={playbackUrl} controls /> : null}
    </>
  );
}
```

## Screen Recording

```tsx
import { useDisplayMedia, useMediaRecorder, useObjectUrl } from 'react-webcam-kit';

export function ScreenRecorder() {
  const screen = useDisplayMedia({ audio: true, video: true });
  const recorder = useMediaRecorder({
    fileName: 'screen-recording',
    fileType: 'webm',
    quality: 'hd',
    stream: screen.stream,
  });
  const playbackUrl = useObjectUrl(recorder.blob);

  return (
    <>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => void screen.start()}>
        Share screen
      </button>
      <button type="button" disabled={!screen.stream} onClick={() => recorder.start()}>
        Record
      </button>
      <button type="button" onClick={recorder.stop}>
        Stop recording
      </button>
      {playbackUrl ? <video src={playbackUrl} controls /> : null}
    </>
  );
}
```

Start display capture from a user action. `useDisplayMedia()` returns `status`, `stream`, `error`,
`isSupported`, `start()`, and `stop()`. It also handles the user ending sharing from the browser UI.

## QR And Barcode Scanner Screens

Use `useCameraPermissions()` before rendering a dedicated scanner package, or pair `useWebcam()` with the browser `BarcodeDetector` API when supported. Keep decoder packages optional unless the whole app needs scanning. Prefer `facingMode: { ideal: 'environment' }` for mobile QR and barcode scanner screens.

## Advanced Track Constraints

```tsx
const [track] = camera.stream?.getVideoTracks() ?? [];
const capabilities = track?.getCapabilities?.();

if (capabilities && 'torch' in capabilities) {
  await camera.applyVideoConstraints({
    advanced: [{ torch: true } as MediaTrackConstraintSet],
  });
}
```

Use feature detection for torch, zoom, focus distance, exposure, and similar hardware-specific controls. Browsers expose different capabilities on different devices.

## Error Handling

Camera errors are normalized into typed values. Use `error.type` for UI decisions.

Common categories include:

- permission denied
- device not found
- device already in use
- overconstrained constraints
- insecure context
- unsupported browser
- unknown media error

Do not assume permission is granted before calling `start()`. Do not assume device labels are visible before permission is granted.

## SSR And Framework Notes

- Camera APIs are browser-only.
- In Next.js, Remix, Astro, and similar frameworks, render camera components on the client.
- Do not call `navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia` during SSR.
- If dynamically importing a camera component, disable SSR for that component.

## Browser Rules

- Requires HTTPS or localhost.
- Requires `navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia`.
- Screen recording requires `navigator.mediaDevices.getDisplayMedia`.
- Recording requires `MediaRecorder`.
- MIME support varies. Use `getSupportedMimeType()`.
- iOS and Android camera switching works best with `facingMode: { ideal: 'user' }` or `facingMode: { ideal: 'environment' }`.
- Canvas screenshot capture can fail if the video is not ready or the browser blocks canvas reads.
